name: MUTAG
description: A benchmark of 188 nitroaromatic compounds represented as graphs, classified according to their mutagenic effect on the bacterium Salmonella typhimurium. This record does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Debnath, A. K., Lopez de Compadre, R. L., Debnath, G., Shusterman, A. J., & Hansch, C. (1991). Structure-activity relationship of mutagenic aromatic and heteroaromatic nitro compounds. Correlation with molecular orbital energies and hydrophobicity. Journal of Medicinal Chemistry, 34(2), 786–797. https://doi.org/10.1021/jm00106a046
